closed.title: The log stream is closed
closed.description: The daemon refused the stream or the connection dropped, and retries did not help. There are at most four log streams across all tabs: close the extra ones and reconnect.

lost.description: The tab could not keep up with the stream, and the daemon dropped lines. You can reload the log tail.

empty.title: No lines
empty.description: sing-box has not written anything at level {{level}} or above yet, or the log was cleared. New lines appear here on their own.
